page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with two coin medallions (woodcut portraits) at the top, centred above the text block. No margin notes. Running head at top centre with page number at top left. Text ends with the last full line; no catchword or signature.

main_text.l: [woodcut medallion of Charles VIII, legend: CAROLVS · FRAN · REX; and medallion of Anne of Brittany, legend: ANNA BRIT · D · FRAN · R; these are illustrations, not text]
CAROLVS, huius nominis octauus Fracorum Rex suc-
cedit patri Ludouico, anno mundi 5445. à Christo nato 1483.
annum fere attingens 14. Hic bellum aduersus Britones mouit:
ad fanum Aibini insignem de Britannis, seu Britonibus victo-
riam reportauit, vix liquidè dimidia pars exercitus aduersario-
rum superfuit. Rex religiosè nimis Hispano Regi Rufcinonis,
& Perpiniani Comitatus reddidit. Regnum Neapolitanum re-
cuperat, principibus & nobilibus militantibus suis sumptibus:
Romæ à Papa Imperator Constantinopolitanus pronuntiatur.
Alphonsus Portugalliæ Rex, cum filio Ferdinando in Siciliam
fugit. Neapolim cum pompa, & triumpho ingreditur Rex. Vni-
uersi Italiæ principes & ciuitates coeunt vt obsessis itineribus
Regem intercludat, qui nobilem & ingentem victoriā Forno-
uiensem reportans (cùm tamen perquàm modicas copias habe-
ret) victor in Franciam rediit. Sed Neapolis ad Ferdinādū post
annū defecit. Rex repentina morte obiit Amboesiæ, nullis reli-
ctis liberis, anno regni 14. sepultus est in æde Diui Dionysij ad
Parisios. Vixit annos fere 27. porrò mortuus est, dum animi la-
xandi gratia ex ambulacro cum vxore pila ludentes aspicit. Vi-
de Rober. Gaguin. lib. 10. & 11. & Paul. Aemyl. lib. 10. & vltimo.
Latinè scire Carolum pater vetuerat, præter hoc vnū, Qui
nescit simulare, nescit regnare. Collegium proftitutarum pœniten-
tium, hoc Rege, Lutetiæ instituitur: & conuentus trium ordi-
num in vrbe Turonum fit.
ANNA, Francisci Britanniæ Ducis maior natu filia, patre
mortuo nupsit Carolo octauo reconciliatis Britonibus, com-
plurésque liberos ex eo peperit, quibus tamen omnibus super-
uixit pater. Cæterum repudiata Margareta Maximiliani Impe-
ratoris filia, Annam hanc, prius eidem Maximiliano per lega-
tum nuptam, in vxorē duxit Carolus octauus anno salutis 1489.

page.notes: Woodcut medallions at the top are illustrations and carry the legends CAROLVS · FRAN · REX and ANNA BRIT · D · FRAN · R, not transcribed as text. A stain sits at left beside the first paragraph. Doubtful readings: "Fracorum" and "Fornouiensem" are printed as shown. "Ferdinādū" carries a macron as printed. Several letters in the first paragraph are slightly blurred, but the words are legible.
